Government College of Engineering & Ceramic Technology (GCECT), Kolkata.
Affiliation: An Autonomous Institution under MAKAUT.
Address: 73, Abinash Chandra Banerjee Ln, Subhas Sarobar Park, Phoolbagan, Beleghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700010.
Website: https://gcect.ac.in/

GCECT is located at:
73, Abinash Chandra Banerjee Ln, Subhas Sarobar Park, Phoolbagan, Beleghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700010.
Website: https://gcect.ac.in/

The HOD of the IT Department is Prof. (Dr.) Mausumi Maitra (Mazumdar).
Office: Room 301, Floor 3, Administrative Building, GCECT.

You can view the complete IT Department faculty list here:
https://gcect.ac.in/department-of-information-technology/

The IT Department is on Floor 3 of the Administrative Building, GCECT.
Address: 73, Abinash Chandra Banerjee Ln, Beleghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700010.
The IT Department office is open from 10 AM to 5 PM on working days.
The GCECT Library is open from 10 AM to 5 PM on working days.
Laboratory / Practical class timings: 2:10 PM to 5 PM.

Semester 1 (16 Credits):
Theory: Mathematics-I, Physics, Basic Electrical Engineering, English.
Labs: Physics Lab, BEE Lab, Engineering Graphics & Design, English Communication Lab.
Note: Includes a mandatory 3-week induction program.

Semester 2 (22.5 Credits):
Theory: Mathematics-II, Chemistry, Programming for Problem Solving, Analog and Digital Electronics, Universal Human Values.
Labs: Chemistry Lab, Programming Lab, Workshop/Manufacturing Practices, Electronics Lab, Design Thinking Lab, NSS.
Note: 2 to 4 weeks summer training/internship, evaluated in 3rd semester.

Semester 3 (26 Credits):
Theory: Mathematics-III, Communication Engineering, Computer Organization, Data Structure & Algorithms, Economics for Engineers, Environmental Sciences.
Labs: CO Lab, DSA Lab, IT Workshop (Python), Communication Engineering Lab, Summer Internship 1.

Semester 4 (24 Credits):
Theory: Discrete Mathematics, Design & Analysis of Algorithm, Formal Language and Automata Theory, Computer Architecture, Biology for Engineers, Constitution of India.
Labs: Algorithm Lab, Programming Lab (C++), Project 1 (part 1).
Note: 2 to 4 weeks summer training/internship, evaluated in 5th semester.

Semester 5 (25.5 Credits):
Theory: Operating Systems, Database Management System, Object Oriented Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Open Elective-1 (Control System / Microprocessor / DSP / Advanced Computer Architecture).
Labs: OS Lab, DBMS Lab, Java Lab, Open Elective Lab, Project 1 (part 2), Summer Internship 2.

Semester 6 (25 Credits):
Theory: Computer Networks, Compiler Design, Software Engineering, Introduction to Cyber Security, Elective-I, Open Elective-II.
Labs: CN Lab, SE Lab, Elective-I Lab, Project 1 (part 3).
Note: 4 to 6 weeks industrial training in summer, evaluated in 7th semester.

Semester 7 (20 Credits):
Theory: Elective-II, Elective-III, Elective-IV, Open Elective-III, Industrial Management.
Labs: Project 2 / Internship / Industrial Project, Industrial Training.

Semester 8 (7 Credits):
Theory: No theory papers in this semester.
Labs: Project 3 / Internship / Industrial Project, Comprehensive Viva Voce.

First Year (Sem 1 & 2):

Sem 1 (16 Credits): Maths-I, Physics, BEE, English + Labs + 3-week induction.

Sem 2 (22.5 Credits): Maths-II, Chemistry, Programming, Electronics, UHV + Labs + Summer Internship (evaluated in Sem 3).

Second Year (Sem 3 & 4):

Sem 3 (26 Credits): Maths-III, Comm Engg, CO, DSA, Economics, EVS + Labs + Summer Internship 1.

Sem 4 (24 Credits): Discrete Maths, DAA, FLAT, COA, Biology, Constitution of India + Labs + Project 1 (part 1).

Third Year (Sem 5 & 6):

Sem 5 (25.5 Credits): OS, DBMS, OOP, AI, Open Elective-1 + Labs + Summer Internship 2.

Sem 6 (25 Credits): Computer Networks, Compiler Design, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electives + Labs + Industrial Training.

Fourth Year (Sem 7 & 8):

Sem 7 (20 Credits): Elective-II, III, IV, Open Elective-III, Industrial Management + Project 2 + Industrial Training.

Sem 8 (7 Credits): No theory — only Project 3 / Internship and Comprehensive Viva Voce.

Data Structure & Algorithms (Code: PC(IT)302) - Semester 3, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Algorithm analysis; arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues; trees, heaps, graphs; searching and sorting; hashing.

Operating Systems (Code: PC(IT)511) - Semester 5, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Processes and threads; CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks; memory management and virtual memory; file systems; disk and I/O management; protection and security.

Database Management System (Code: PC(IT)512) - Semester 5, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: ER model; relational algebra and SQL; normalization; transactions and concurrency control; indexing and B+ trees.

Artificial Intelligence (Code: PC(IT)514) - Semester 5, 3 Credits (L-T-P: 3-0-0).
Topics: Intelligent agents; search techniques (BFS, A*, minimax); knowledge and reasoning; machine learning and planning; generative AI tools and applications.

Computer Networks (Semester 6).
Topics: OSI and TCP/IP model; routing and switching; network security; transport protocols (TCP, UDP); wireless and cellular networking.

Computer Organization (Code: PC(IT)301) - Semester 3, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Instruction set and processor design; control unit design; memory subsystem; peripherals and I/O (DMA, RAID); pipelining.

Design & Analysis of Algorithm (Code: PC(IT)406) - Semester 4, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Design paradigms (divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking); sorting; graph algorithms; string matching; amortized analysis; P and NP.

Formal Language and Automata Theory (Code: PC(IT)407) - Semester 4, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Finite automata and regular languages; context-free grammars and pushdown automata; context-sensitive languages; Turing machines; undecidability.

Object Oriented Programming (Code: PC(IT)513) - Semester 5, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: OOP concepts and Java basics; inheritance, polymorphism, abstract classes, interfaces, packages; exception handling; multithreading; applets.

Computer Architecture (Code: PC(IT)408) - Semester 4, 4 Credits (L-T-P: 3-1-0).
Topics: Pipelining and hazards; memory modules; cache and virtual memory; instruction-level parallelism (RISC, VLIW); multiprocessors; VHDL and CAD tools.

Discrete Mathematics (Code: BS(IT)409) - Semester 4, 3 Credits (L-T-P: 3-0-0).
Topics: Number theory; counting and recurrence relations; propositional logic; algebraic structures and Boolean algebra; planar graphs and graph colouring.

Software Engineering (Semester 6).
Topics: SDLC models (Agile, Waterfall); requirements engineering; design patterns; testing strategies; project management; UML.

Introduction to Cyber Security (Semester 6).
Topics: Cryptography; network security; ethical hacking basics; firewalls; intrusion detection; security protocols; cyber laws.

Mathematics-III (Code: BS(IT)307) - Semester 3, 3 Credits (L-T-P: 3-0-0).
Topics: Fourier series and transforms; multivariable calculus (differentiation and integration); ordinary differential equations; graph theory.

Communication Engineering (Code: ES(IT)309) - Semester 3, 3 Credits (L-T-P: 3-0-0).
Topics: AM, FM and PM; sampling, PCM and digital modulation (ASK, FSK, PSK); line codes; wireless and cellular communication basics.

Semester examinations are held from 12 PM to 3 PM (3-hour duration).
Check the official schedule: https://gcect.ac.in/semester-examination-schedule/

You can find the latest semester examination schedule and routine here:
https://gcect.ac.in/semester-examination-schedule/

Exam Pattern (most theory papers):
Internal (50 marks): Mid-Semester 1 = 15, Mid-Semester 2 = 15, Assignments/Quiz/Attendance = 20.
End Semester Exam: 100 marks converted to 50.
Total: 100 marks.

Lab papers: Graded on attendance, lab report, experimental work, presentation, and viva.

Documents required for GCECT admission:
- Aadhaar card
- PAN card
- Ration card
- Domicile certificate
- Class 10 marksheet
- Class 12 marksheet
- Caste certificate (if applicable)
- Income certificate

For the latest procedure, visit: https://gcect.ac.in/

The approximate annual tuition fee for B.Tech IT at GCECT is Rs. 13,200.
Please confirm the latest fee details with the college office.

GCECT offers the following financial support:
- Student Freeship
- SVMCM (Swami Vivekananda Merit cum Means Scholarship)

Contact the college office or visit https://gcect.ac.in/ for application details.

The IT Department has an active Training & Placement Cell.
For placement details, recruiters, and statistics, visit:
https://gcect.ac.in/training-placement-dept-of-it/

The IT Department has a vibrant technical club called Bytemonk.
Bytemonk organizes coding contests, workshops, hackathons, and tech events for IT students.

Internship & Training at GCECT IT:
- Summer Internship 1: 2-4 weeks after Sem 2, evaluated in Sem 3
- Summer Internship 2: 2-4 weeks after Sem 4, evaluated in Sem 5
- Industrial Training: 4-6 weeks after Sem 6, evaluated in Sem 7
- Sem 7 & 8: Project / Internship / Industrial Project (final evaluation)

For hostel and accommodation details, please contact the college office directly or visit https://gcect.ac.in/ as information is subject to updates.

B.Tech IT at GCECT (Curriculum 2024-25 onwards) - 8 Semesters across 4 years:
- Sem 1-2: Foundation (Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Programming)
- Sem 3-4: Core IT (DSA, CO, DAA, FLAT, Computer Architecture)
- Sem 5-6: Advanced IT (OS, DBMS, OOP, AI, Networks, Cyber Security)
- Sem 7-8: Electives, Industrial Training, Projects & Viva
- Internships after Sem 2, Sem 4, and Sem 6

Ask about any specific semester for full details!
